book_metadata.title: La Cartilla de Gretel - Workbook & Core Reader
book_metadata.author: Leonor Lopetegui

_instructions_for_agent: This is the master content manifest. Every page entry contains: page_number, ui_component_type, letter_focus, all text content, and asset slots. Asset slots with null paths need to be matched to files in public/cartilla/art/hd/flipchart/ using the description field. Replace null with the matched filename. Merge completed paths into public/cartilla/art/manifest.json.
